description.en: An outdoor street performance in Zagreb city centre: we walk with the lamplighter and sing as he lights the lanterns. Free and open to everyone.
description.hr: Nastup na ulici u središtu Zagreba: hodamo uz nažigača i pjevamo dok pali lanterne. Besplatno i otvoreno za sve.
